item.description:
Bouncebin 1.1.2

  • It is not just for Logic. Bounces are bounces, whatever made them. Projects from Ableton, Reaper, FL Studio, Cubase, Pro Tools, Studio One, Bitwig, Ardour and GarageBand are now recognised the way Logic's always were, so bounces next to them are spotted properly and Open project opens the right one.
  • An empty library now explains itself instead of telling you there is nothing in it. Three things, in the order they happen, and the keys worth knowing.
  • Copy everything as it is, don't convert. A new option in Settings for when you would rather your library matched your renders exactly. It is a lot more disk — a five-minute WAV is around 50 MB against 7 as MP3 — so it stays off unless you ask.
  • The 3D sleeve no longer has scratches on it. The shrink wrap says it better.
